items.uz: Kompaniya kutilmagan inqirozga tayyor emas edi.
items.en: The company wasn't prepared for the unexpected crisis.

items.uz: Rahbariyat tezkor qaror qabul qilishga majbur bo'ldi.
items.en: The management was forced to make a quick decision.

items.uz: Bu vaziyatda sovuqqonlikni saqlash muhim.
items.en: In this situation, maintaining composure is important.

items.uz: Jamoa inqirozdan chiqish yo'llarini izladi.
items.en: The team searched for ways out of the crisis.

items.uz: Bunday holatlarda aniq kommunikatsiya hal qiluvchi ahamiyatga ega.
items.en: In such situations, clear communication is of decisive importance.

items.uz: Ular zudlik bilan choralar ko'rishga kirishishdi.
items.en: They immediately set about taking measures.

items.uz: Bu inqiroz kompaniyaning zaif tomonlarini ochib berdi.
items.en: This crisis revealed the company's weaknesses.

items.uz: Muvaffaqiyatli boshqaruv qiyin damlarda sinaladi.
items.en: Successful management is tested in difficult moments.

items.uz: Jamoa a'zolari birlashib, muammoni yengib chiqishdi.
items.en: The team members united and overcame the problem.

items.uz: Har bir inqiroz kelajak uchun muhim saboq beradi.
items.en: Every crisis teaches an important lesson for the future.

items.uz: Bunday vaziyatlarda tezkorlik va aniqlik talab etiladi.
items.en: Speed and precision are required in such situations.

items.uz: Inqirozdan so'ng kompaniya yanada mustahkamlandi.
items.en: After the crisis, the company became even stronger.

lessons.title: Personal Growth & Self-Improvement
lessons.titleNative: Shaxsiy rivojlanish va o'z ustida ishlash

items.uz: Har kuni o'zimni bir qadam oldinga siljitishga harakat qilaman.
items.en: I try to move myself one step forward every day.

items.uz: O'z ustida ishlash doimiy jarayon.
items.en: Working on oneself is a continuous process.

items.uz: U o'z kamchiliklarini tan olib, ular ustida ishladi.
items.en: He/she acknowledged his/her shortcomings and worked on them.

items.uz: Kitob o'qish meni ichki dunyoyimni boyitadi.
items.en: Reading books enriches my inner world.

items.uz: Har bir muvaffaqiyatsizlik meni kuchliroq qiladi.
items.en: Every failure makes me stronger.

items.uz: Men o'z maqsadlarimni aniq belgilashni o'rgandim.
items.en: I learned to clearly define my goals.

items.uz: O'zini anglash baxtli hayotning kalitidir.
items.en: Self-awareness is the key to a happy life.

items.uz: U doim yangi ko'nikmalar egallashga intiladi.
items.en: He/she always strives to acquire new skills.

items.uz: Meditatsiya menga ichki tinchlik topishga yordam beradi.
items.en: Meditation helps me find inner peace.

items.uz: Har bir qiyinchilik meni rivojlanishga undaydi.
items.en: Every difficulty encourages me to develop.

items.uz: O'zgarish qo'rqinchli, ammo zarur.
items.en: Change is scary, but necessary.

items.uz: Men kelajakdagi o'zimga g'amxo'rlik qilyapman.
items.en: I'm taking care of my future self.
